articles.title: Governor Appoints Runoff Winner to Fill Vacant Local Court Seat
articles.excerpt: In May 2018 he defeated Jeff Parker in the Republican primary runoff for the seat, and on June 25, 2018, Gov. Greg Abbott appointed him to serve the rest of the term of Judge Martha Trudo, who had retired earlier that year after 23 years on the bench; he faced no opponent in November 2018 (KWTX).

articles.title: Locals Vying for County Seats in Primary Elections
articles.excerpt: 2026 election: He was unopposed in the March 2026 Republican primary, and no Democrat filed (KDH).
